definitions.gloss: to accomplish; to carry through; to complete
definitions.explanation: To see a task or challenge through to completion, especially one that was difficult. Emphasizes perseverance and finishing what was started.

examples.japanese: ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧やり{遂|と}げた。
examples.english: I saw it through to the end.

examples.japanese: ⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やり{遂|と}げる⟦{自信|じしん}→自信：10143_jishin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: I have confidence that I can carry out this difficult job.

examples.japanese: ⟦どんな→どんな：02924_donna⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{辛|つら}くて→辛い：01112_tsurai⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{途中|とちゅう}→途中：01684_tochuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{諦|あきら}め→諦める：01813_akirameru⟧ず⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やり{遂|と}げること⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧だ。
examples.english: No matter how hard it gets, it's important not to give up halfway and to see it through.

notes:
FORMS:
A compound verb from ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (to do) + ⟦{遂|と}げる→遂げる：14323_togeru⟧ (to accomplish). The combination emphasizes completing a task despite difficulty.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{最後|さいご}→最後：01413_saigo⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧やり{遂|と}げる (to see through to the end)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やり{遂|と}げる (to complete a job)
- ⟦{目標|もくひょう}→目標：03631_mokuhyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧やり{遂|と}げる (to achieve a goal)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成|な}し{遂|と}げる→成し遂げる：12632_nashitogeru⟧: to accomplish — more formal, used for significant achievements
- ⟦やり→やる：02980_yaru⟧きる: to do completely — emphasizes exhausting effort
